review_route.rationale: A forged dirty snapshot can omit affected work while retaining a current candidate binding and can therefore produce a false conservative-plan result.

material_finding.summary: DirtySnapshot::new is public while RoutineBinding and DirtyChange are cloneable and publicly observable. A caller can capture a legitimate current snapshot, clone its binding, retain only a nonempty subset of changes, mint a structurally valid replacement snapshot, and make plan_routine omit affected checks.
material_finding.contract_impact: LiveContext revalidation proves that the cloned binding is current but does not prove that the caller-supplied change set is the complete captured dirty state. Conservative affected-set behavior and verified routine reuse therefore remain false-passable.

required_correction: make dirty snapshot construction crate-confined or require opaque capture provenance that planning validates against the complete live capture
prevent public clone or serde surfaces from minting an accepted partial snapshot
add an external compile-fail control for DirtySnapshot construction and a behavioral partial-change forgery control
rerun the exact routine contract suite and both prior forged-authority probes against the corrected current set
highest_defensible_ceiling: Source correction intent only. Routine behavior, verified reuse, public integration, and routine completion remain unaccepted.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim acceptance, public integration, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
